average-rate.def: The change in a quantity divided by the change in the input over an interval: $\frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a}$. It is the slope of the line through $(a, f(a))$ and $(b, f(b))$, in output units per input unit.

instantaneous-rate.def: How fast a quantity is changing at one instant: the number that average rates of change over shorter and shorter intervals around that instant close in on.
